top_deficiency_types.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Install an approved automatic sprinkler system.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Ensure each resident receives and the facility provides food that accommodates resident allergies, intolerances, and preferences, as well as appealing options.
Have a registered nurse on duty 8 hours a day; and  select a registered nurse to be the director of nurses on a full time basis.
Dispose of garbage and refuse properly.
Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.
